errors.workdrive_outdated: This WorkDrive doesn’t support app connections yet. Ask your WorkDrive admin to update it, then try again.
errors.workdrive_unreachable: We couldn’t reach WorkDrive at this address. Check the address, or try again in a few minutes.
errors.workdrive_unavailable: WorkDrive can’t be reached right now. Try again shortly.
media.askAdmin: Ask a workspace admin to connect WorkDrive.
media.connectBody: Media is stored in your WorkDrive. Connect it once and everyone on the team can upload and reuse files.
media.dropHint: Images up to {image} MB, videos up to {video} MB.
media.dropTitle: Drop a file here or click to upload
media.emptyFolder: This folder has no images or videos.
media.missing: This file was removed from WorkDrive. Upload it again or choose another file.
media.title: Media
workdrive.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can connect WorkDrive.
workdrive.desc: Store this workspace’s post media, brand logos and deliverables in your WorkDrive.
workdrive.disconnectBody: Files stay in WorkDrive. Posts and logos keep their links, but images won’t load until you connect again.
workdrive.keyHint: In WorkDrive, open Admin Console → App Access Keys, create a key with file and folder access, and limit it to a folder such as OMA.
workdrive.keyInvalid: This doesn’t look like a complete key. It starts with wdk_.
workdrive.layout: Files are organized as {path} brand / posts, logos, deliverables.
workdrive.notConnected: WorkDrive isn’t connected yet. Media can’t be uploaded until it is.
workdrive.testFailed: WorkDrive didn’t respond as expected. Check the key below.
workdrive.title: Imkan WorkDrive
workdrive.urlHint: The address of your WorkDrive server, for example https://imkan-workdrive-v1.onrender.com.
companies.email_not_configured: Email sending isn't set up for this workspace yet, so no email was sent. Copy the secure invitation link below and share it with your teammate.
